column1: [controls] PC: what does holding left click do?
column2:
PC: left click shoots; hold left click for a power shot; right click passes to a teammate.
https://illegalsoccer.wiki/guides/controls/ patch 2026-11

column1: [controls] Default flick key on PC (most guides)?
column2:
PC (most-cited layout): Q flick, F lob, R request ball, Space dribble, Shift sprint, E slide tackle. Sources conflict, so check the in-game keybind menu.
https://robloxdatabase.com/guides/illegal-soccer-controls/ patch 2026-11

column1: [controls] How do you curve a shot on PC?
column2:
Curve shot: hold middle mouse while shooting and drag left/right to bend that way; controller = hold LT+RT and push right stick when the meter appears.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-how-to-curve-shot-controller-and-keyboard/ patch 2026-11

column1: [scoring] Why must a flick-shot kick be fully charged?
column2:
Flick shot (most-cited reliable goal): press Q to pop the ball up, jump after it, and charge the kick fully in the air toward the top of the net; partial charge drops short and is an easy catch.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-roblox-tips-for-flick-shots-and-goalkeeper-saves/ patch 2026-11

column1: [dribbling] Which actions cost a full stamina bar?
column2:
Stamina costs (fan-reported): dribble and slide tackle = full bar; kick/shot ~half; flick ~half; pass and lob ~quarter.
https://allthings.how/illegal-soccer-dribbling-guide-stamina-costs-and-7-ball-techs/ patch 2026-11

column1: [defense] What happens after a missed slide tackle?
column2:
Only slide when the carrier is in reach: a missed slide locks you in a recovery animation and leaves nothing behind you. Press E when they are closest, don't spam.
https://illegalsoccer-roblox.wiki/guides/defense/ patch 2026-11

No keeper button: standing in the rectangle in front of your own net makes you keeper (catch, punch, dive); leaving/sprinting out ends it; one keeper at a time.
https://illegalsoccergame.wiki/skills/goalie/ patch 2026-11

column1: [items] Two S-tier items in every tier list?
column2:
Tier lists agree: Jetpack and Rocket Punch are S-tier; Freeze Gun S or A; Grappling Hook usually A; Energy Drink D in every list.
https://progameguides.com/roblox/roblox-illegal-soccer-items-tier-list/ patch 2026-11

column1: [items] Rarest item and its drop chance?
column2:
Item drop rates (fan-reported, pre-update 14 items): Barricades/Energy Drink/Forcefield/Supercharge 12.5% each; Jetpack 1% (rarest); Bazooka and Freeze Gun ~3.5%; Flintlock/Landmines/Oil Spill/Rocket Punch ~4.7%; Grappling Hook/Magnet/Shotgun ~7%.
https://www.sportskeeda.com/roblox-news/all-items-illegal-soccer patch pre-Nov-2026

Ranked has two queues with separate Elo: Illegal (items on) and Legal (items off). Needs 5 owned items to enter; 10 placement matches.
https://savepointmag.com/2026/10/07/illegal-soccer-roblox-en/ patch 2026-11

Last Chance rule: if the trailing team is down by one when time ends, play continues until they lose possession; if they score, it goes to overtime.
